```{r 1}
# SURFACE CODES, from the two DNIT sources:
#   PAV   paved                DUP  dual carriageway (paved)
#   EOD   works on duplicated/paved road
#   N_PAV not paved            LEN  natural bed (dirt)     IMP  graded, unpaved
#   EOP   works on paving
#   PLA / EOI planned or opening works, no drivable roadway
#   TRV   crossing / ferry, excluded
#
# Both surfaces are kept and classified. Filtering on `== "PAV"` would discard
# every unpaved road -- in the Amazon the frontier-access channel, and so the
# half most relevant to the outcome -- and would also drop DUP, which is paved.
# `way_road` stays defined as PAVED so anything reading it keeps its meaning.
#
# Road length is measured AFTER intersecting the municipal polygons, so the
# numerator sits on the same Legal-Amazon-clipped boundary as `areamun`.
#
# TWO DISTINCT DUPLICATIONS ARE REMOVED, and they are different problems.
#
#   WITHIN-SOURCE (concurrency). Where one roadbed carries two BR designations,
#   DNIT stores one feature per designation inside the federal file with
#   byte-identical geometry, and summing both counts the same road twice. An
#   exact-WKB equality test removes these, separately per source. Inside the
#   772-municipality clip that is 1,656 km, 84% of it federal paved.
#
#   CROSS-SOURCE (overlap). The same physical highway appears in DNIT's federal
#   SNV file and again in the state CIDE file. The two agencies digitise
#   independently, so the geometries are close but never equal and an equality
#   test cannot see them. Detection needs a distance tolerance. The federal copy
#   is kept and the state one dropped: DNIT is the authority for its own network
#   and the federal file carries the finer surface field. 2,232 km inside the
#   clip.
#
# Together these are 3.9% of drivable kilometres, concentrated in municipalities
# crossed by concurrent highways -- a proportional bias, not white noise.
ROAD_EOP_AS = "unpav"          # under construction, paved: counted as unpaved
ROAD_PAVED = c("PAV", "DUP", "EOD")
ROAD_UNPAVED = c("N_PAV", "LEN", "IMP")
ROAD_PLANNED = c("PLA", "EOI") # no roadbed on the ground; excluded
ROAD_DROP = c("TRV")           # ferry crossing, no roadbed

# Cross-source detection. Each state piece is sampled every SPACING_M metres and
# a point counts as shared when it lies within TOL_M of any federal line.
#
# WHY MIN_RUN EXISTS. Proximity alone cannot tell "runs along" from "crosses". A
# state road meeting a federal one at right angles has one sample point inside
# the buffer at the junction, and counting that point as overlap deletes road
# that is not duplicated at all -- and every junction in the network is such a
# point, so the bias is systematic rather than incidental. Requiring MIN_RUN
# CONSECUTIVE near-points separates the two: a crossing gives a run of 1 (rarely
# 2, at an oblique angle) while a shared roadbed gives a long unbroken run. At
# 100 m spacing, MIN_RUN = 3 means a stretch counts only once at least 300 m of
# the state line has stayed within 50 m of federal road. Sample points come back
# ordered along the line, so consecutive positions are consecutive on the ground.
# Pieces too short to hold a qualifying run count only if EVERY sample point is
# near federal road, which applies the same sustained test at the piece's own
# length.
#
# Length removed is len * fraction, so municipal TOTALS stay exact and only the
# split between shared and unshared is approximated: point sampling never
# becomes a second source of error in the kilometre counts.
ROAD_TOL_M = 50       # two lines this close are the same roadbed
ROAD_SPACING_M = 100  # one sample point per this much state road
ROAD_MIN_RUN = 3      # consecutive near-points required to call it shared

road_classify = function(surf) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    surf %in% ROAD_DROP ~ NA_character_,
    surf %in% ROAD_PLANNED ~ NA_character_,
    surf %in% ROAD_PAVED ~ "pav",
    surf == "EOP" ~ ROAD_EOP_AS,
    TRUE ~ "unpav"
  )
}

# Byte-identical geometries within one source.
road_dup_flag = function(x) {
  duplicated(vapply(
    sf::st_as_binary(sf::st_geometry(x)),
    function(b) paste0(as.character(b), collapse = ""),
    character(1)
  ))
}

road_read = function(zip_path, layer, surf_col) {
  x = st_read(paste0("/vsizip/", zip_path, "/", layer), quiet = TRUE) %>%
    rename(surf = all_of(surf_col)) %>%
    mutate(surf = as.character(surf))

  unknown = setdiff(
    unique(x$surf),
    c(ROAD_PAVED, ROAD_UNPAVED, ROAD_PLANNED, ROAD_DROP, "EOP", NA)
  )
  if (length(unknown)) {
    message(sprintf(
      "  road_read(%s): UNRECOGNISED surface code(s) sent to unpav: %s",
      basename(zip_path), paste(unknown, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  x %>%
    mutate(klass = road_classify(surf)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(klass)) %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    st_transform(crs = proj_wk) %>%
    st_make_valid()
}

# Clip to municipalities and measure each piece, dropping within-source
# duplicates first so a duplicated roadbed is not clipped twice.
road_clip = function(x, mun_layer) {
  x[!road_dup_flag(x), ] %>%
    select(klass) %>%
    st_intersection(mun_layer) %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    mutate(len_m = as.numeric(st_length(geometry))) %>%
    filter(len_m > 0)
}

road_mun_layer = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>% select(codmun)

fed_roads = road_read(paste0(DRAW, "DNIT/202201B.zip"), "SNV_202201B.shp",
                      "ds_sup_fed")
sta_roads = road_read(paste0(DRAW, "DNIT/vw_cide_rod_2021.zip"),
                      "vw_cide_rod_2021.shp", "Superficie")

fed_clip = road_clip(fed_roads, road_mun_layer)
sta_clip = road_clip(sta_roads, road_mun_layer)
rm(fed_roads, sta_roads)
gc()

# Share of each state piece that sits on a federal roadbed.
#
# BUFFER + st_intersects, NOT st_is_within_distance. The two answer the same
# question, but point-to-line distance is computed pairwise against every
# candidate while point-in-polygon goes through the STRtree -- at this many
# query points that is the difference between minutes and tens of minutes.
sta_lines = st_cast(st_geometry(sta_clip), "LINESTRING", warn = FALSE)
n_pts = pmax(1L, as.integer(round(as.numeric(st_length(sta_lines)) /
                                    ROAD_SPACING_M)))
sample_pts = st_line_sample(sta_lines, n = n_pts)
sample_sf = st_sf(
  piece = rep(seq_len(nrow(sta_clip)), lengths(sample_pts)),
  geometry = st_cast(sample_pts, "POINT")
)
near_fed = lengths(st_intersects(
  sample_sf, st_buffer(st_geometry(fed_clip), ROAD_TOL_M)
)) > 0

shared_fraction = function(h) {
  if (!any(h)) return(0)
  if (length(h) < ROAD_MIN_RUN) return(if (all(h)) 1 else 0)
  r = rle(h)
  sum(r$lengths[r$values & r$lengths >= ROAD_MIN_RUN]) / length(h)
}
by_piece = split(near_fed, sample_sf$piece)
frac = vapply(by_piece, shared_fraction,
              numeric(1))[as.character(seq_len(nrow(sta_clip)))]
frac[is.na(frac)] = 0
sta_clip$len_keep = sta_clip$len_m * (1 - as.numeric(frac))

cat(sprintf(
  "cross-source: %.0f km of state road shares a federal roadbed (%.1f%% of state km)\n",
  sum(sta_clip$len_m - sta_clip$len_keep) / 1000,
  100 * sum(sta_clip$len_m - sta_clip$len_keep) / sum(sta_clip$len_m)
))
rm(sta_lines, n_pts, sample_pts, sample_sf, near_fed, by_piece, frac)
gc()

# Federal kilometres in full, state kilometres net of the shared stretches.
roadway = bind_rows(
  st_drop_geometry(fed_clip) %>% transmute(codmun, klass, km = len_m / 1000),
  st_drop_geometry(sta_clip) %>% transmute(codmun, klass, km = len_keep / 1000)
) %>%
  group_by(codmun, klass) %>%
  summarise(km = sum(km), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = klass, values_from = km,
              names_prefix = "way_road_", values_fill = 0)

# The active specification uses paved-road length only. Keep the all-surface
# source reconciliation above because it determines which state-road stretches
# duplicate federal roads, but discard the unused unpaved and neighbor measures
# before writing the municipal input.
roadway = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>%
  select(codmun, areamun) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(roadway, by = "codmun") %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("way_road_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    way_road_pav = replace_na(way_road_pav, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(codmun, way_road_pav)

rm(fed_clip, sta_clip, road_mun_layer)
gc()


# Operating railways.
#
# Length is measured ONCE, after a SINGLE intersection with the municipal layer,
# so each split piece carries its own length. An earlier version intersected,
# computed st_length, then intersected a second time while carrying the
# already-computed length column forward: the second pass split features again
# and every piece kept the full pre-split length, so the group_by sum
# double-counted. Measured on the railway layer, that read 3,886 km against the
# correct 2,902 km (+34%); `way_water` and `way_total` were built the same way
# and were inflated the same way.
mun_layer = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>% select(codmun)

# Operating railway only. Matched on a normalised, case-folded substring rather
# than on the exact accented literal "Em Operacao": the source encoding of
# tip_situac is not stable across reads, and an exact match that silently fails
# returns zero kilometres rather than an error.
railway = st_read(
  paste0("/vsizip/", DRAW, "DNIT/BaseFerro.zip/BaseFerro/BaseFerro.shp"),
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(grepl("opera", tolower(iconv(as.character(tip_situac),
                                      to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")))) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_wk) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_intersection(mun_layer) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(km = as.numeric(units::set_units(st_length(geometry), "km"))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(codmun) %>%
  summarise(way_rail = sum(km), .groups = "drop")

# The operating network inside the Legal Amazon is about 2,902 km over roughly
# 70 municipalities. A total near 3,886 means the double-count above is back.
stopifnot(abs(sum(railway$way_rail) - 2902) < 50)

rm(mun_layer)


# 2021 municipal mobile coverage
mobile = read_csv2(unz(
  paste0(DRAW, "ANATEL/cobertura_movel.zip"),
  "Atributos_Setores_Censo_2010.csv"
)) %>%
  select(
    setor = `Código Setor Censitário`,
    area = `Área (km2)`,
    codmun = `Código Município`
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    read_csv2(unz(
      paste0(DRAW, "ANATEL/cobertura_movel.zip"),
      "Cobertura_2021_11_Setores.csv"
    )) %>%
      filter(Operadora == "Todas") %>%
      select(setor = `Código Setor Censitário`, coverarea = Cobertura_Todas),
    by = "setor"
  ) %>%
  arrange(setor) %>%
  mutate(
    setor = as.character(setor),
    coverarea = ifelse(is.na(coverarea), 0, coverarea)
  ) %>%
  group_by(codmun) %>%
  summarise(coverarea = weighted.mean(x = coverarea, w = area))


# Tenure areas
uc_area = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "uc")]]$zone %>%
  group_by(codmun) %>%
  summarise(
    areauc = sum(areauc),
    geometry = st_union(geometry)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

ti_area = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "ti")]]$zone %>%
  group_by(codmun) %>%
  summarise(
    areati = sum(areati),
    geometry = st_union(geometry)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

sett_area = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "sett")]]$zone %>%
  group_by(codmun) %>%
  summarise(
    areasett = sum(areasett),
    geometry = st_union(geometry)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

ndpf_area = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "ndpf")]]$zone %>%
  group_by(codmun) %>%
  summarise(
    areandpf = sum(areandpf),
    geometry = st_union(geometry)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_drop_geometry()


# Joining datasets
mun = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  merge(2017:2025) %>%
  rename(year = y) %>%
  left_join(mobile, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(dist, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(latlong, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(microreg_lookup, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(roadway, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(railway, by = "codmun") %>%
  mutate(across(c(way_road_pav, way_rail), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  # `areamun` covers only the Legal Amazon portion. Match its extent with
  # `pop_areawt`: area-weighted census-tract population for the 21 partially
  # included Maranhao municipalities and full population for all others.
  left_join(
    readRDS(paste0(DV, "pop_clipped.RDS")) %>%
      select(codmun, pop_areawt, clipped_pop_share),
    by = "codmun"
  ) %>%
  # Population density uses the population and area inside the panel boundary.
  mutate(dens = pop_areawt / areamun) %>%
  left_join(ti_area, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(uc_area, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(sett_area, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(ndpf_area, by = "codmun") %>%
  left_join(
    sicar_area %>%
      select(codmun, areasicar21_large, areasicar21_small),
    by = "codmun"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    overlap_area %>%
      select(codmun, areaover_ndpf_large, areaover_ndpf_small),
    by = "codmun"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    starts_with("area") | starts_with("n_sicar"),
    ~ replace_na(., 0)
  )) %>%
  select(
    codmun, uf, areamun, pop, year, coverarea,
    dist_coast, dist_brasilia, lat, lon, microreg,
    way_road_pav, way_rail, dens,
    areati, areauc, areasett, areandpf,
    areasicar21_large, areasicar21_small,
    areaover_ndpf_large, areaover_ndpf_small
  ) %>%
  arrange(codmun, year)

saveRDS(mun, paste0(DV, "munic.RDS"))
rm(
  mun,
  mobile,
  dist,
  latlong,
  microreg_lookup,
  ti_area,
  uc_area,
  sett_area,
  ndpf_area,
  sicar_area,
  overlap_area,
  roadway,
  railway
)
```


## 2. FOREST DEGRADATION

```{r 2}
# DETER forest degradation alerts
deter = st_read(paste0(
  paste0("/vsizip/", DRAW),
  DETER_zip,
  "/deter-amz-deter-public.shp"
)) %>%
  rename(class = CLASSNAME) %>%
  select(-GEOCODIBGE) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(VIEW_DATE),
    class = case_when(
      class == "CICATRIZ_DE_QUEIMADA" ~ "deter_degr_fire",
      class == "DEGRADACAO" ~ "deter_degr_outr",
      class == "CS_DESORDENADO" ~ "deter_degr_wood",
      class == "CS_GEOMETRICO" ~ "deter_degr_wood",
      class == "CORTE_SELETIVO" ~ "deter_degr_wood",
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2016 & year <= 2025 & !is.na(class)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_wk) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(alert_id = row_number())


process_zone = function(deter, zone, prefix) {
  area_col = paste0("area_", prefix, "_deter_degr")
  n_col = paste0("n_", prefix, "_deter_degr")

  x = deter %>%
    st_intersection(zone) %>%
    st_make_valid()
  # Two polygons that merely touch produce a zero-area line or point piece.
  # It is not an alert inside the zone, and it would count as one.
  x = x[as.numeric(st_area(st_geometry(x))) > 0, ]

  out = x %>%
    mutate(
      class = ifelse(class == "", NA, class),
      month = month(VIEW_DATE)
    ) %>%
    group_by(codmun, year, month, class) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(alert_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(area = as.numeric(units::set_units(st_area(.), km^2))) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = class,
      values_from = c(area, n),
      names_glue = paste0("{.value}_", prefix, "_{class}")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(matches("^(area_|n_)"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
      !!area_col := rowSums(
        across(starts_with(paste0("area_", prefix, "_deter_degr_"))),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      !!n_col := rowSums(
        across(starts_with(paste0("n_", prefix, "_deter_degr_"))),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(codmun, year, month) %>%
    summarise(across(matches("^(area_|n_)"), sum), .groups = "drop")

  # Only the municipal series is used by degradation type. The tenure results
  # use totals, so discard their unused fire/wood/other splits immediately.
  if (prefix != "mun") {
    out = out %>% select(codmun, year, month, all_of(c(area_col, n_col)))
  }
  out
}

active_deter_prefixes = c(
  "mun", "ti", "uc", "sett", "ndpf",
  "sicar21_large", "sicar21_small",
  "over_ndpf_large", "over_ndpf_small"
)
active_deter_zones = zones[zones_prefixes %in% active_deter_prefixes]

options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)
plan(multisession, workers = min(max_workers, length(active_deter_zones)))
tictoc::tic("parallel")

results = future_lapply(
  active_deter_zones,
  function(z) process_zone(deter, z$zone, z$prefix)
)

tictoc::toc()
plan(sequential) # Parallelization (END)

# Recombine municipality shards that share a prefix.
results_combined = list()

active_deter_zone_prefixes = vapply(active_deter_zones, function(z) z$prefix, character(1))
for (p in unique(active_deter_zone_prefixes)) {
  idx = which(active_deter_zone_prefixes == p)
  results_combined[[p]] = bind_rows(results[idx]) %>%
    group_by(codmun, year, month) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop")
}

# Now join â€” each element has unique column names
deter = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>%
  select(codmun) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  merge(2016:2025) %>%
  rename(year = y) %>%
  merge(1:12) %>%
  rename(month = y) %>%
  arrange(codmun, year, month)

for (res in results_combined) {
  deter = deter %>% left_join(res, by = c("codmun", "year", "month"))
}
rm(results)

deter = deter %>%
  mutate_at(
    vars(starts_with("area_"), starts_with("n_")),
    ~ replace(., is.na(.), 0)
  )


saveRDS(
  deter %>% select(codmun, year, month, area_mun_deter_degr_fire),
  paste0(DV, "deter_monthly.RDS")
)

saveRDS(
  deter %>%
    filter(year >= 2017 & year <= 2025) %>%
    group_by(codmun, year) %>%
    summarise(
      across(starts_with("area_") | starts_with("n_"), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      codmun, year,
      area_mun_deter_degr, area_mun_deter_degr_fire,
      area_mun_deter_degr_wood, area_mun_deter_degr_outr,
      area_ti_deter_degr, area_uc_deter_degr, area_sett_deter_degr,
      area_ndpf_deter_degr, area_sicar21_large_deter_degr,
      area_sicar21_small_deter_degr, area_over_ndpf_large_deter_degr,
      area_over_ndpf_small_deter_degr,
      n_mun_deter_degr, n_mun_deter_degr_fire,
      n_mun_deter_degr_wood, n_mun_deter_degr_outr,
      n_ti_deter_degr, n_uc_deter_degr, n_sett_deter_degr,
      n_ndpf_deter_degr, n_sicar21_large_deter_degr,
      n_sicar21_small_deter_degr, n_over_ndpf_large_deter_degr,
      n_over_ndpf_small_deter_degr
    ),
  paste0(DV, "deter_normalyr.RDS")
)

rm(
  deter, process_zone, results_combined, res,
  active_deter_prefixes, active_deter_zones, active_deter_zone_prefixes
)
```


## 3A. DEFORESTATION - PRODES

```{r 3A-prodes}
# PRODES deforestation 6.25 ha or higher, Legal Amazon product. This must not
# point to the Amazon-biome zip: the estimation sample is the full
# administrative Legal Amazon, matching DETER and the municipal panel.
prodes = st_read(
  paste0(paste0("/vsizip/", DRAW), PRODES_zip, "/", PRODES_LAYER, ".shp")
) %>%
  rename(class = sub_class) %>%
  mutate(
    class = case_when(
      class == "corte raso com solo exposto" ~ "prodes_defo_cces",
      class == "corte raso com vegetação" ~ "prodes_defo_ccwv",
      class == "mineração" ~ "prodes_defo_mine",
      class == "desmatamento por degradação progressiva" ~ "prodes_defo_dpdp",
      TRUE ~ "prodes_defo_NA"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2017 & year <= 2025) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_wk) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  select(year, class) %>%
  mutate(poly_id = row_number())   # v2: unique source polygon, see chunk 2

process_zone = function(prodes, zone, prefix) {
  area_col = paste0("area_", prefix, "_prodes_defo")
  n_col = paste0("n_", prefix, "_prodes_defo")

  x = prodes %>%
    st_intersection(zone) %>%
    st_make_valid()
  x = x[as.numeric(st_area(st_geometry(x))) > 0, ]

  x %>%
    mutate(
      class = ifelse(class == "", NA, class)
    ) %>%
    group_by(codmun, year, class) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(poly_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(area = as.numeric(units::set_units(st_area(.), km^2))) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = class,
      values_from = c(area, n),
      names_glue = paste0("{.value}_", prefix, "_{class}")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(matches("^(area_|n_)"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
      !!area_col := rowSums(
        across(starts_with(paste0("area_", prefix, "_prodes_defo_"))),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      !!n_col := rowSums(
        across(starts_with(paste0("n_", prefix, "_prodes_defo_"))),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(codmun, year) %>%
    summarise(across(matches("^(area_|n_)"), sum), .groups = "drop")
}


tictoc::tic("parallel")
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)
plan(multisession, workers = min(max_workers, length(zones))) # Parallelization

results = future_lapply(
  zones,
  function(z) process_zone(prodes, z$zone, z$prefix)
)

plan(sequential) # Parallelization (END)
tictoc::toc()


# Recombine chunks sharing the same prefix
results_combined = list()

for (p in unique(zones_prefixes)) {
  idx = which(zones_prefixes == p)
  results_combined[[p]] = bind_rows(results[idx]) %>%
    group_by(codmun, year) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop")
}

# Joining tenures
prodes = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>%
  select(codmun) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  merge(2017:2025) %>%
  rename(year = y) %>%
  arrange(codmun, year)

for (res in results_combined) {
  prodes = prodes %>% left_join(res, by = c("codmun", "year"))
}

prodes = prodes %>%
  mutate_at(
    vars(starts_with("area_"), starts_with("n_")),
    ~ replace(., is.na(.), 0)
  )

# The only locally available 1.0--6.25 ha supplement is biome-specific. Joining
# it here created a mixed-footprint `prodfull` series. Do not rebuild that series
# unless INPE supplies the same supplement for the Legal Amazon. Active v3
# results use the standard >=6.25 ha `*_prodes_defo` outcomes.
saveRDS(prodes, paste0(DV, "prodes_full.RDS"))


rm(prodes, results, results_combined, process_zone, res)
```

```{r 4}
      artigo_1 %in%
        as.character(c(24:42, 84)) |
        artigo_2 %in% as.character(c(24:42, 84)) ~ "Fauna",
      artigo_1 %in%
        as.character(c(43:60, 85)) |
        artigo_2 %in% as.character(c(43:60, 85)) ~ "Flora",
      artigo_1 %in%
        as.character(61:71) |
        artigo_2 %in% as.character(61:71) ~ "Pollution",
      artigo_1 %in%
        as.character(c(72:83, 86:90)) |
        artigo_2 %in% as.character(c(72:83, 86:90)) ~ "Administrative",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),

    desc_ai = stri_replace_all_regex(
      desc_ai,
      "[\\x00-\\x08\\x0B\\x0C\\x0E-\\x1F]",
      ""
    ),
    desc_ai = stri_trans_nfc(desc_ai),
    desc_ai = str_to_lower(desc_ai, locale = "pt"),
    desc_ai = stri_trans_general(desc_ai, "Latin-ASCII"), # remover acentos para facilitar matching
    desc_ai = str_squish(desc_ai), # normalizar espaços

    ATIVIDADE = case_when(
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$DegradDeforest)) ~ "DegradDeforest",
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$Logging)) ~ "Logging",
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$Crop)) ~ "Crop",
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$Livestock)) ~ "Livestock",
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$Wildlife)) ~ "Wildlife",
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$Pollution)) ~ "Pollution",
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$Mining)) ~ "Mining",
      any(str_detect(desc_ai, rx$Administrative)) ~ "Administrative",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

    TIPO_INFRACAO = ifelse(
      !is.na(TIPO_INFRACAO),
      TIPO_INFRACAO,
      case_when(
        ATIVIDADE %in% c("DegradDeforest", "Logging", "Crop") ~ "Flora",
        ATIVIDADE %in% c("Livestock", "Wildlife") ~ "Fauna",
        ATIVIDADE %in% c("Pollution", "Mining") ~ "Pollution",
        ATIVIDADE %in% c("Administrative", "Other") ~ "Administrative"
      )
    ),

    dummy_fire = 1 *
      (any(str_detect(desc_ai, c("fogo", "incendi", "queima"))) &
        !str_detect(desc_ai, "arma de fogo") |
        artigo_1 == "58" |
        artigo_2 == "58"),

    dummy_flor = 1 * (TIPO_INFRACAO == "Flora"),
    dummy_faun = 1 * (TIPO_INFRACAO == "Fauna"),
    dummy_polu = 1 * (TIPO_INFRACAO == "Pollution"),
    dummy_admi = 1 * (TIPO_INFRACAO == "Administrative")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    year,
    month,
    dummy_fire,
    dummy_flor,
    dummy_faun,
    dummy_polu,
    dummy_admi
  )
```

## 6. AIR POLLUTION

```{r 6}
sum_coverage = function(x) {
  list(
    x %>%
      # Normalize only over cells with valid climate values. CHIRTS-ERA5 and
      # CHIRPS store missing cells as -9999 without declaring GDAL NoData, and
      # including their covered area in the denominator implicitly assigns 0
      # to missing coastal observations.
      filter(is.finite(value), is.finite(coverage_area)) %>%
      mutate(
        total_area = sum(coverage_area, na.rm = T),
        proportion = coverage_area / total_area,
        product = value * proportion
      ) %>%
      select(product)
  )
}


# (a) Build task list: split each PM size into n_chunks temporal chunks
n_chunks = 3

tasks = list()
for (PM_SIZE in c("1", "2.5", "10")) {
  N = sub("\\.", "p", PM_SIZE)
  PM_clean = sub("\\.", "", PM_SIZE)

  # Read layer metadata only (dates)
  aux = rast(paste0(DRAW, "CAMS-EAC4/data_sfc.nc"), subds = paste0("pm", N))
  dates = time(aux)
  stopifnot(length(dates) == nlyr(aux), !anyNA(dates))

  # Resume check: find which layers still need processing in v3.
  files = list.files(
    DV,
    pattern = paste0("pm", PM_clean, "mun")
  )

  month_id = format(dates, "%Y-%m")
  completed_months = if (length(files) > 0) {
    basename(files) %>%
      sub(paste0("pm", PM_clean, "mun_"), "", x = ., fixed = TRUE) %>%
      sub(".RDS", "", x = ., fixed = TRUE) %>%
      sub("_", "-", x = ., fixed = TRUE)
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  keep = which(!month_id %in% completed_months)

  if (length(keep) > 0) {
    # Keep every calendar month inside one task so parallel workers never write
    # partial versions of the same monthly cache.
    layers_by_month = split(keep, month_id[keep])
    n_groups = min(n_chunks, length(layers_by_month))
    month_chunks = split(
      seq_along(layers_by_month),
      cut(seq_along(layers_by_month), n_groups, labels = FALSE)
    )
    chunks = lapply(
      month_chunks,
      function(i) unname(unlist(layers_by_month[i], use.names = FALSE))
    )

    for (ch in seq_along(chunks)) {
      tasks[[length(tasks) + 1]] = list(
        PM_SIZE = PM_SIZE,
        N = N,
        PM_clean = PM_clean,
        layers = chunks[[ch]]
      )
    }
  } else {
    message(paste0("PM", PM_SIZE, " already complete â€” skipping"))
  }
}

rm(aux)
message(paste0(
  "Total tasks: ",
  length(tasks),
  " (up to ",
  n_chunks,
  " chunks x 3 PM sizes)"
))


# (b) Run extraction in parallel â€” one task per chunk
amz_nogeo = zones[[1]]$zone %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(codmun)

{
  # Parallelization
  options(future.globals.maxSize = 4 * 1024^3)
  # max(1, ...) because `tasks` is EMPTY once every month is already extracted
  # -- this is a build-once step and the cached path is the normal one. Without
  # the floor, plan() gets workers = 0 and stops with "'workers >= 1' is not
  # TRUE". future_lapply over an empty list is a no-op, so nothing else changes.
  plan(multisession, workers = max(1, min(max_workers, length(tasks))))

  future_lapply(
    tasks,
    function(task) {
      library(terra)
      library(lubridate)
      library(exactextractr)
      library(dplyr)
      library(sf)
      library(tibble)

      PM_SIZE = task$PM_SIZE
      N = task$N
      PM_clean = task$PM_clean
      lyrs = task$layers

      # Each worker reloads the raster (terra is not serializable), but projects
      # only its assigned temporal chunk. Projecting the full stack here would
      # repeat the same expensive work once for every chunk.
      r = rast(paste0(DRAW, "CAMS-EAC4/data_sfc.nc"), subds = paste0("pm", N))

      all_dates = time(r)
      stopifnot(length(all_dates) == nlyr(r), !anyNA(all_dates))

      dates = all_dates[lyrs]
      r = r[[lyrs]] %>%
        project(proj_wk) %>%
        crop(zones[[1]]$zone, snap = "out")

      # The reported data are monthly means. Averaging projected cells first is
      # algebraically equivalent to averaging their area-weighted municipal
      # means. A direct same-geometry check matched the original three-hourly
      # extraction path to machine precision, while reducing 23,376 municipal
      # extractions per PM size to 96.
      month_id = format(dates, "%Y-%m")
      month_levels = unique(month_id)
      r = tapp(
        r,
        index = match(month_id, month_levels),
        fun = mean,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      dates = as.POSIXct(paste0(month_levels, "-01"), tz = "UTC")

      ano = year(dates)
      mes = month(dates)
      dia = day(dates)
      hora = hour(dates)

      pm_mun = tibble()

      for (idx in seq_len(nlyr(r))) {
        tif = r[[idx]]
        y = ano[idx]
        m = mes[idx]
        d = dia[idx]
        h = hora[idx]

        ext = exact_extract(
          tif,
          zones[[1]]$zone,
          coverage_area = TRUE,
          progress = FALSE,
          max_cells_in_memory = 3e+9,
          summarize_df = TRUE,
          fun = sum_coverage
        )

        pm_mun = bind_rows(
          pm_mun,
          bind_cols(
            amz_nogeo,
            year = y,
            month = m,
            day = d,
            hour = h,
            pm_mun = sapply(ext, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
          )
        )

        # Save at month boundary or end of chunk
        is_last = (idx == nlyr(r))
        is_month_end = (!is_last && mes[idx + 1] != m)

        if (is_last || is_month_end) {
          pm_mun %>%
            group_by(codmun, year, month) %>%
            summarise(pm_mun = mean(pm_mun), .groups = "drop") %>%
            saveRDS(paste0(
              paste0(DV, "pm"),
              PM_clean,
              "mun_",
              y,
              "_",
              sprintf("%02d", m),
              ".RDS"
            ))
          pm_mun = tibble()
        }
      }

      invisible(NULL)
    },
    future.seed = TRUE
  )

  plan(sequential)
}


# (c) Joining all RDS into final dataset
pm_files = list.files(
  DV,
  pattern = "^pm\\d+mun_",
  full.names = TRUE
)
stopifnot(length(pm_files) > 0)  # empty: PM municipal extracts missing from DV

pm_mun = map_dfr(pm_files, function(f) {
  # Extract PM size from filename (e.g., "pm25mun_2017_01.RDS" â†’ "2.5")
  pm_code = sub("^pm(\\d+)mun_.*", "\\1", basename(f))
  readRDS(f) %>%
    mutate(
      pm_mun = pm_mun * 1e9, # kg/m3 -> ug/m3
      pmsize = pm_code
    )
})

# The per-month caches may predate the Santarem+Mojui merge; re-extracting the
# CAMS rasters for one municipality is not worth days of compute. PM is an
# area-weighted municipal MEAN, so the pair's cached rows merge with their
# original clipped areas as weights. No-op once caches are rebuilt post-merge.
if (any(pm_mun$codmun == MOJUI_CODMUN)) {
  pm_mun = bind_rows(
    pm_mun %>% filter(!codmun %in% MOJUI_PAIR_W$codmun),
    pm_mun %>%
      filter(codmun %in% MOJUI_PAIR_W$codmun) %>%
      left_join(MOJUI_PAIR_W, by = "codmun") %>%
      group_by(year, month, pmsize) %>%
      summarise(pm_mun = weighted.mean(pm_mun, w_area), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(codmun = SANTAREM_CODMUN)
  )
}

# V3 compatibility: the accepted results were generated when temporal chunks
# split two months. The earlier worker fragments became the saved values: the
# first 8 three-hourly observations of September 2019 and the first 16 of May
# 2022. Reproduce those two locked inputs explicitly; all other monthly caches
# use complete calendar months and the task builder never splits a month.
v3_boundaries = tibble::tribble(
  ~year, ~month, ~n_layers,
  2019L, 9L, 8L,
  2022L, 5L, 16L
)

v3_compat = tibble()
for (PM_SIZE in c("1", "2.5", "10")) {
  N = gsub(".", "p", PM_SIZE, fixed = TRUE)
  PM_clean = gsub(".", "", PM_SIZE, fixed = TRUE)
  r_boundary = rast(
    paste0(DRAW, "CAMS-EAC4/data_sfc.nc"),
    subds = paste0("pm", N)
  )
  dates_boundary = time(r_boundary)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(v3_boundaries))) {
    year_i = v3_boundaries$year[i]
    month_i = v3_boundaries$month[i]
    idx_boundary = which(
      year(dates_boundary) == year_i & month(dates_boundary) == month_i
    )[seq_len(v3_boundaries$n_layers[i])]

    tif = r_boundary[[idx_boundary]] %>%
      project(proj_wk) %>%
      crop(zones[[1]]$zone, snap = "out") %>%
      mean(na.rm = TRUE)

    ext = exact_extract(
      tif,
      zones[[1]]$zone,
      coverage_area = TRUE,
      progress = FALSE,
      max_cells_in_memory = 3e9,
      summarize_df = TRUE,
      fun = sum_coverage
    )

    v3_compat = bind_rows(
      v3_compat,
      bind_cols(
        amz_nogeo,
        year = year_i,
        month = month_i,
        pm_mun = sapply(ext, sum, na.rm = TRUE) * 1e9,
        pmsize = PM_clean
      )
    )
  }
}

pm_mun = pm_mun %>%
  anti_join(
    v3_compat %>% select(codmun, year, month, pmsize),
    by = c("codmun", "year", "month", "pmsize")
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(v3_compat)
pm_mun = pm_mun %>%
  group_by(codmun, year, month, pmsize) %>%
  summarise(pm_mun = mean(pm_mun), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pm_m")) %>%
  mutate(name = paste0("pm", pmsize, substr(name, 4, nchar(name)))) %>%
  select(-pmsize) %>%
  pivot_wider()

saveRDS(pm_mun, paste0(DV, "pmcams_monthly.RDS"))

saveRDS(
  pm_mun %>%
    filter(year >= 2017 & year <= 2025) %>%
    group_by(codmun, year) %>%
    summarise(
      pm1mun = mean(pm1mun),
      pm10mun = mean(pm10mun),
      pm25mun = mean(pm25mun)
    ) %>%
    ungroup(),
  paste0(DV, "pmcams_normalyr.RDS")
)

rm(list = intersect(
  c(
    "pm_mun", "pm_files", "amz_nogeo", "sum_coverage", "tasks", "n_chunks",
    "chunks", "v3_boundaries", "v3_compat", "r_boundary", "dates_boundary",
    "idx_boundary", "tif", "ext"
  ),
  ls()
))
```

## 7. MAX TEMPERATURE AND PRECIPITATION

```{r 7}
bbox = st_bbox(zones[[1]]$zone %>% st_transform(4326)) + c(-.5, -.5, .5, .5)
amz_nogeo = zones[[1]]$zone %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(codmun)

sum_coverage = function(x) {
  list(
    x %>%
      mutate(
        total_area = sum(coverage_area, na.rm = T),
        proportion = coverage_area / total_area,
        product = value * proportion
      ) %>%
      select(product)
  )
}

# Generic worker function â€” each file is one task
extract_raster_file = function(
  filepath,
  varname,
  yr_start,
  yr_len,
  mo_start,
  mo_len,
  nodata = NULL
) {
  library(terra)
  library(exactextractr)
  library(sf)
  library(dplyr)

  tif = rast(filepath) %>% crop(bbox)
  if (!is.null(nodata)) {
    tif[tif == nodata] = NA
  }
  tif = tif %>% project(proj_wk)

  f = basename(filepath)
  y = as.numeric(substr(f, yr_start, yr_start + yr_len - 1))
  m = as.numeric(substr(f, mo_start, mo_start + mo_len - 1))

  ext = exact_extract(
    tif,
    zones[[1]]$zone,
    coverage_area = TRUE,
    progress = FALSE,
    summarize_df = TRUE,
    fun = sum_coverage
  )

  bind_cols(
    amz_nogeo,
    year = y,
    month = m,
    !!varname := sapply(ext, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

## 8. SPEI-12 (Copernicus ERA5-Drought)

```{r 8}
# The selected drought control is the deterministic Copernicus ERA5-Drought
# SPEI-12 product. Its provider calculation uses ERA5 reanalysis and
# Penman--Monteith PET. The standalone extractor reads only the December and
# July endpoint files needed for the calendar and PRODES-year panels, projects
# them to the common Albers CRS, and computes coverage-area-weighted municipal
# values. Run it in a clean R process so its parallel plan and package state do
# not leak into this long data-construction session.
spei_script = file.path(code_dir, "spei_copernicus_era5.R")
spei_zip_candidates = file.path(
  DRAW,
  "Copernicus",
  c(
    "SPEI-12_Amazon_2017_2025.zip",
    "SPEI-12_Amazon_2016_2025.zip", # earlier compact archive
    "SPEI-6-12_Amazon_1940_2025.zip" # legacy shared archive
  )
)
spei_zip = spei_zip_candidates[file.exists(spei_zip_candidates)][1]
stopifnot(
  file.exists(spei_script),
  length(spei_zip) == 1,
  !is.na(spei_zip),
  file.exists(file.path(DV, "mun_zone.RDS"))
)

spei_env = c(
  paste0(
    "STARLINK_SPEI_DATA_DIR=",
    normalizePath(DFINAL, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  ),
  paste0(
    "STARLINK_SPEI_OUTPUT_DIR=",
    normalizePath(DV, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  ),
  paste0(
    "STARLINK_SPEI_MUN_ZONE_RDS=",
    normalizePath(
      file.path(DV, "mun_zone.RDS"),
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = TRUE
    )
  ),
  paste0(
    "STARLINK_COPERNICUS_SPEI_ZIP=",
    normalizePath(spei_zip, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  ),
  paste0("SPEI_COPERNICUS_MAX_WORKERS=", max_workers)
)
spei_status = system2(
  file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
  args = c(shQuote(normalizePath(spei_script, winslash = "/")), "12"),
  env = spei_env
)
stopifnot(identical(as.integer(spei_status), 0L))

stopifnot(
  file.exists(file.path(DV, "spei12_copernicus_era5_normalyr.RDS")),
  file.exists(file.path(DV, "spei12_copernicus_era5_prodesyr.RDS"))
)
rm(spei_script, spei_zip_candidates, spei_zip, spei_env, spei_status)
```

## 9. MORTALITY RATES

```{r 9}
mun = zones[[1]]$zone %>%
  select(codmun, pop) %>%
  mutate(codmun6 = as.numeric(substr(codmun, 1, 6))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

deaths = tibble()
files = c(
  "Mortalidade_Geral_2017_csv.zip",
  "Mortalidade_Geral_2018_csv.zip",
  "Mortalidade_Geral_2019_csv.zip",
  "Mortalidade_Geral_2020_csv.zip",
  "Mortalidade_Geral_2021_csv.zip",
  "DO22OPEN_csv.zip",
  "DO23OPEN_csv.zip",
  "DO24OPEN_csv.zip"
)

for (file in files) {
  if (substr(file, nchar(file) - 2, nchar(file)) == "zip") {
    aux = read_csv2(unz(
      paste0(paste0(DRAW, "DATASUS/"), file),
      gsub("_(?=[^_]*$)", ".", gsub("\\.zip$", "", file), perl = TRUE)
    ))
  } else {
    aux = read_csv2(paste0(paste0(DRAW, "DATASUS/"), file))
  }

  aux = aux %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.numeric(substr(DTOBITO, 5, 8)),
      month = as.numeric(substr(DTOBITO, 3, 4)),
      cid = toupper(CAUSABAS),
      cid_l = substr(cid, 1, 1),
      cid_n = as.numeric(substr(cid, 2, 3)),
      type = case_when(
        # http://tabnet.datasus.gov.br/cgi/sih/mxcid10lm.htm
        cid_l == "A" | cid_l == "B" ~ "infect",
        cid_l == "C" | (cid_l == "D" & cid_n <= 48) ~ "neoplasm",
        cid_l == "D" & cid_n >= 49 ~ "blood",
        cid_l == "E" ~ "endocrine",
        cid_l == "F" ~ "mental",
        cid_l == "G" ~ "nervous",
        cid_l == "H" & cid_n <= 59 ~ "eyes",
        cid_l == "H" & cid_n >= 60 ~ "ears",
        cid_l == "I" ~ "circulatory",
        cid_l == "J" | (cid_l == "U" & cid_n == 4) ~ "respiratory",
        cid_l == "K" ~ "digestive",
        cid_l == "L" ~ "skin",
        cid_l == "M" ~ "musculoskeletal",
        cid_l == "N" ~ "genitourinary",
        cid_l == "O" ~ "pregnancy",
        cid_l == "P" ~ "perinatal",
        cid_l == "Q" ~ "malformation",
        cid_l == "R" ~ "other",
        cid_l %in% c("S", "T", "V", "W", "X", "Y") ~ "extcause",
        cid_l == "Z" | cid_l == "U" ~ "other",
      )
    ) %>%
    rename(codmun6 = CODMUNOCOR) %>%
    # SIM keys on 6-digit codes; Mojui's deaths fold into the merged unit here,
    # since the lookup below (built from merged zones) no longer carries its code
    mutate(codmun6 = ifelse(as.numeric(codmun6) == MOJUI_CODMUN %/% 10,
                            SANTAREM_CODMUN %/% 10, as.numeric(codmun6))) %>%
    left_join(mun, by = "codmun6")

  deaths = bind_rows(
    deaths,
    # Total Deaths
    aux %>%
      mutate(type = "total") %>%
      group_by(codmun, year, month, type) %>%
      summarise(qty = n()) %>%
      ungroup(),
    # Deaths by ICD
    aux %>%
      group_by(codmun, year, month, type) %>%
      summarise(qty = n()) %>%
      ungroup()
  )
}

  merge(2017:2025) %>%

  left_join(deaths, by = c("codmun", "year", "month")) %>%
  mutate(qty = qty / (pop / 1e5)) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "type",
    names_prefix = "mort_",

    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  select(codmun, year, month, mort_total, starts_with("mort_"))
```

## 10. FOREST COVER AND TRANSITIONS

```{r 10}
# Forest cover and land-cover transitions are extracted as PIXEL COUNTS: the
# exact_extract callbacks below count every pixel whose cell intersects the
# municipal polygon, without weighting by the fraction of the cell that falls
# inside it. So `area_floresta` and `area_total` are counts, and `p_forest` is a
# ratio of counts.
#
# This is a decision, not an oversight. The area-weighted alternative
# (coverage_area = TRUE, after reprojecting to the IBGE Albers WKT) was computed
# for forest area and all nine transitions and gives the same results, so the
# simpler and faster pixel-count form is retained. Boundary error under pixel
# counting scales with perimeter over area and is therefore largest in small and
# irregular municipalities; it does not move any reported estimate.
mun = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>%
  st_make_valid()

# Rasters are in geographic coordinates, so the extraction polygons must be too.
mun = mun %>% st_transform(4326) %>% st_make_valid()

# Land cover class groupings
forest_classes = c(1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 49)
natural_nonforest = c(10, 11, 12, 32, 29, 50, 13)
agriculture_pec = c(15)
agriculture_agr = c(18, 19, 39, 20, 40, 62, 41, 36, 46, 47, 35, 48)
agriculture_out = c(14, 9, 21)
nonveg_min = c(30)
nonveg_urb = c(24)
other_destination = c(22, 23, 25, 75, 26, 33, 31)

make_transitions = function(from, to, label) {
  expand.grid(from = from, to = to) %>%
    mutate(code = from * 100 + to, category = label)
}

transition_table = bind_rows(
  make_transitions(forest_classes, forest_classes, "sh_flo"),
  make_transitions(forest_classes, natural_nonforest, "sh_veg"),
  make_transitions(forest_classes, agriculture_pec, "sh_agr_pec"),
  make_transitions(forest_classes, agriculture_agr, "sh_agr_agr"),
  make_transitions(forest_classes, agriculture_out, "sh_agr_out"),
  make_transitions(forest_classes, nonveg_min, "sh_nvg_min"),
  make_transitions(forest_classes, nonveg_urb, "sh_nvg_urb"),
  # Needed only so every retained sh_* share keeps the original forest-origin
  # denominator. This catch-all is discarded before raster_trans() returns.
  make_transitions(forest_classes, other_destination, "sh_other")
  # Pasture â†’ crops
  # Non-forest â†’ forest (regeneration, needed for last-year forest area)
) %>%
  distinct(code, category) %>%
  mutate(cat_id = as.integer(factor(category)))

# All category labels in cat_id order (for column naming)
cat_labels = transition_table %>%
  distinct(cat_id, category) %>%
  arrange(cat_id) %>%
  pull(category)
output_cat_labels = setdiff(cat_labels, "sh_other")
shm_labels = "shm_agr_pec"

n_cats = length(cat_labels)
reclass_mat = as.matrix(transition_table[, c("code", "cat_id")])


# MapBiomas raster file paths
period = 2016:2024 # <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
flist = list.files(
  paste0(DRAW, "MapBiomas"),
  pattern = "^brazil_coverage.*\\.tif$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
stopifnot(length(flist) > 0)  # empty: no MapBiomas coverage raster matches this period
flist = flist[str_detect(flist, pattern = paste(period, collapse = "|"))]
period_actual = period[seq_along(flist)]

if (length(flist) < 2) {
  stop("At least two MapBiomas coverage rasters are required for transitions.")
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transition function: returns forest-origin transition shares with two bases:
# sh_*  = transition cells / prior-year forest-origin cells
# shm_* = transition cells / prior-year total valid municipal cells
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
raster_trans = function(raster_ini, raster_end, poly) {
  transition_raster = raster_ini * 100 + raster_end
  transition_category_raster = classify(
    transition_raster,
    rcl = reclass_mat,
    others = NA
  )

  ext = exact_extract(
    transition_category_raster,
    poly,
    progress = FALSE,
    fun = function(values, coverage_fraction) {
      as.list(table(values))
    },
    max_cells_in_memory = 3e+10
  )

  total_cells = exact_extract(
    raster_ini,
    poly,
    progress = FALSE,
    fun = function(values, coverage_fraction) {
      sum(!is.na(values))
    },
    max_cells_in_memory = 3e+10
  )

  df = tibble(id = seq_along(ext), values = ext) %>%
    unnest_wider(values, names_sep = "_")

  required_cols = paste0("values_", seq_len(n_cats))
  missing_cols = setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    df[missing_cols] = 0
  }

  df = df %>%
    select(id, all_of(required_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(
      all_of(required_cols),
      ~ replace_na(as.numeric(unlist(.x)), 0)
    ))

  colnames(df) = c("id", cat_labels)

  df = df %>%
    mutate(
      sh_total = rowSums(across(all_of(cat_labels)), na.rm = TRUE),
      total_cells = as.numeric(total_cells)
    )

  # Only pasture is used with the municipal-area denominator in the
  # normalization robustness table.
  df$shm_agr_pec = df$sh_agr_pec / df$total_cells

  df = df %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cat_labels), ~ .x / sh_total)) %>%
    select(id, all_of(output_cat_labels), all_of(shm_labels))

  df = poly %>%
    select(codmun) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    bind_cols(df) %>%
    select(-id)

  return(df)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main loop: parallelized by state
# Each worker reloads rasters from disk and produces transitions + p_forest.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
uflist = sort(unique(substr(mun$codmun, 1, 2)))

# Resume at state boundaries. A state is complete only when BOTH outputs exist;
# a lone file from an interrupted save must be rebuilt rather than silently used.
completed_ufs = uflist[
  file.exists(paste0(DV, "mb_trans_", uflist, "_", period_actual[1], "-",
                     period_actual[length(period_actual)], ".RDS")) &
    file.exists(paste0(DV, "mb_forest_", uflist, ".RDS"))
]
if (length(completed_ufs) > 0) {
  message("MapBiomas states already complete: ", paste(completed_ufs, collapse = ", "))
}
uflist = setdiff(uflist, completed_ufs)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 4 * 1024^3)
{
  plan(multisession, workers = max(1, min(max_workers, 3, length(uflist))))

  invisible(future_lapply(seq_along(uflist), future.seed = TRUE, function(i) {
    library(terra)
    library(exactextractr)
    library(sf)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(purrr)

    uf = uflist[i]
    temp_mun = mun[substr(mun$codmun, 1, 2) == uf, ]
    temp_bbox = st_bbox(temp_mun) + c(-.5, -.5, .5, .5)

    n_rasters = length(flist)

    load_raster = function(k) {
      r = rast(flist[k]) %>% crop(temp_bbox)
      mask(r, temp_mun)
    }

    forest_stats = function(r, year_value) {
      forest_count = exactextractr::exact_extract(
        r,
        temp_mun,
        function(values, coverage_fraction) sum(values %in% forest_classes),
        progress = FALSE,
        max_cells_in_memory = 3e+09
      )

      total_count = exactextractr::exact_extract(
        r,
        temp_mun,
        function(values, coverage_fraction) sum(!is.na(values)),
        progress = FALSE,
        max_cells_in_memory = 3e+09
      )

      tibble(
        codmun = temp_mun$codmun,
        year = year_value,
        area_floresta = as.numeric(forest_count),
        area_total = as.numeric(total_count),
        p_forest = area_floresta / area_total
      )
    }

    trans = data.frame()
    forest_list = vector("list", n_rasters)
    r_prev = load_raster(1)
    forest_list[[1]] = forest_stats(r_prev, period_actual[1])

    for (j in 2:n_rasters) {
      r_curr = load_raster(j)
      forest_list[[j]] = forest_stats(r_curr, period_actual[j])

      aux = raster_trans(
        raster_ini = r_prev,
        raster_end = r_curr,
        poly = temp_mun
      ) %>%
        mutate(year = period_actual[j])
      trans = rbind(trans, aux)

      # Shift: current becomes previous, free memory
      r_prev = r_curr
      rm(r_curr)
      gc()
    }

    rm(r_prev)
    gc()

    saveRDS(
      trans,
      paste0(
        paste0(DV, "mb_trans_"),
        uf,
        "_",
        period_actual[1],
        "-",
        period_actual[n_rasters],
        ".RDS"
      )
    )

    forest = bind_rows(forest_list) %>% arrange(codmun, year)

    saveRDS(forest, paste0(DV, "mb_forest_", uf, ".RDS"))

    invisible(NULL)
  }))

  plan(sequential)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Consolidate state-level files
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
trans_pattern = paste0(
  "^mb_trans_[0-9]{2}_",
  period_actual[1],
  "-",
  period_actual[length(period_actual)],
  "\\.RDS$"
)

# The per-UF caches may predate the Santarem+Mojui merge. Transition AREAS are
# additive (summed), but shm_ columns are SHARES of the old municipal
# area, so the pair merges as an area-weighted mean - identical to the ratio of
# summed areas over summed areamun. No-op once caches are rebuilt post-merge.
mbtrans = list.files(DV, trans_pattern, full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(readRDS) %>%
  select(codmun, year, all_of(output_cat_labels), all_of(shm_labels)) %>%
  arrange(codmun, year)
stopifnot(nrow(mbtrans) > 0)  # empty: transition intermediates missing from DV
if (any(mbtrans$codmun == MOJUI_CODMUN)) {
  mbtrans = bind_rows(
    mbtrans %>% filter(!codmun %in% MOJUI_PAIR_W$codmun),
    mbtrans %>%
      filter(codmun %in% MOJUI_PAIR_W$codmun) %>%
      left_join(MOJUI_PAIR_W, by = "codmun") %>%
      group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(output_cat_labels), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                across(all_of(shm_labels), ~ weighted.mean(.x, w_area, na.rm = TRUE)),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(codmun = SANTAREM_CODMUN)
  ) %>%
    arrange(codmun, year)
}

saveRDS(mbtrans, paste0(DV, "mbtrans.RDS"))

# Forest stock: areas are additive, p_forest is recomputed exactly from the
# summed numerator and denominator.
# Match only the per-state files, not section 12's mb_forest_2024.RDS.
forest_pattern = "^mb_forest_[0-9]{2}\\.RDS$"
mb_forest = list.files(
  DV,
  forest_pattern,
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  map_dfr(readRDS) %>%
  arrange(codmun, year)
# Empty means the forest-stock intermediates are missing from DV, not that the
# region has no forest. Earlier versions of this read wrote empty output silently.
stopifnot(nrow(mb_forest) > 0)
if (any(mb_forest$codmun == MOJUI_CODMUN)) {
  mb_forest = bind_rows(
    mb_forest %>% filter(!codmun %in% MOJUI_PAIR_W$codmun),
    mb_forest %>%
      filter(codmun %in% MOJUI_PAIR_W$codmun) %>%
      group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(area_floresta = sum(area_floresta, na.rm = TRUE),
                area_total = sum(area_total, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(p_forest = area_floresta / area_total,
             codmun = SANTAREM_CODMUN)
  ) %>%
    arrange(codmun, year)
}

saveRDS(mb_forest, paste0(DV, "mb_forest.RDS"))

rm(
  mbtrans,
  mb_forest,
  mun,
  uflist,
  completed_ufs,
  flist,
  period,
  period_actual,
  trans_pattern,
  transition_table,
  reclass_mat,
  cat_labels,
  output_cat_labels,
  shm_labels,
  n_cats,
  forest_classes,
  natural_nonforest,
  agriculture_pec,
  agriculture_agr,
  agriculture_out,
  nonveg_min,
  nonveg_urb,
  other_destination,
  make_transitions,
  raster_trans
)
```

## 11. FIRE IGNITIONS

```{r 11}
# Hotspot dataset from INPE (historical 2001-2020)
hotspots = data.frame()
# All nine states. Seven of these were commented out at some point and left
# that way, which quietly cut the hotspot panels to Mato Grosso and Para -- and
# because the worker count below is min(max_workers, length(ufs)), it also
# throttled the whole chunk to two cores.
ufs = c(
  "ACRE",
  "AMAPÁ",
  "AMAZONAS",
  "MARANHÃO",
  "MATO GROSSO",
  "PARÁ",
  "RONDÔNIA",
  "RORAIMA",
  "TOCANTINS"
)

for (yr in 2019:2025) {
  if (yr %in% c(2016, 2017, 2025)) {
    aux = read_csv(unz(
      paste0(paste0(DRAW, "INPE/focos_br_todos-sats_"), yr, ".zip"),
      paste0("tmp/focos_br_todos-sats_", yr, ".csv")
    ))
  } else {
    aux = read_csv(unz(
      paste0(paste0(DRAW, "INPE/focos_br_todos-sats_"), yr, ".zip"),
      paste0("focos_br_todos-sats_", yr, ".csv")
    ))
  }

  hotspots = rbind(
    hotspots,
    aux %>%
      filter(
        estado %in%
          ufs &
          satelite %in%
            c(
              # THE SENSOR SET, and it is what the manuscript reports: "the
              # VIIRS product from the Suomi-NPP and NOAA-20 platforms". Both
              # cover the whole 2019-2025 window, so the constellation is
              # constant inside the panel and detection counts carry no
              # mechanical trend.
              "NOAA-20"                  # JPSS-1; one label = day (~13:30 LT) + night
              , "NPP-375", "NPP-375D"    # Suomi-NPP, the two BDQueimadas labels
              # , "NOAA-21"  # EXCLUDED: present in only 12 of the 36 months of
              #              # 2022-2024 (from 2024 on), so including it would put
              #              # a step change in detection density inside the
              #              # estimation window. Verified 2026-08-14.
              # , "AQUA_M-T", "AQUA_M-M", "TERRA_M-T", "TERRA_M-M" # MODIS: coarser
              #   1 km product, kept out of the VIIRS series entirely
              #
              # NOTE on Suomi-NPP: its detections dip sharply relative to NOAA-20
              # in Aug 2022 and Jul 2024 (ratio ~0.22 and ~0.26 against a normal
              # ~0.65). Real, but absorbed by the state-by-year fixed effects,
              # which is why NPP stays in the main series rather than being
              # demoted to robustness. Measured 2026-08-14.
            )
      ) %>%
      mutate(data_pas = with_tz(data_pas, tzone = "America/Manaus")) %>%
      select(latitude:satelite, frp, estado, municipio)   # keep frp (MW) for per-ignition FRP/FRE
  )
}

hotspots = hotspots %>%
  mutate(
    sigla_uf = case_when(
      estado == "ACRE" ~ "AC",
      estado == "AMAPÁ" ~ "AP",
      estado == "AMAZONAS" ~ "AM",
      estado == "MARANHÃO" ~ "MA",
      estado == "MATO GROSSO" ~ "MT",
      estado == "PARÁ" ~ "PA",
      estado == "RONDÔNIA" ~ "RO",
      estado == "RORAIMA" ~ "RR",
      estado == "TOCANTINS" ~ "TO"
    )
  )

hotspots = split(hotspots, hotspots$sigla_uf)

# ---- spotoroo clustering: BUILD-ONCE ----------------------------------------
# This is the expensive step in the chunk, and its output is read straight back
# below -- the loop at "Joining extracted ignitions" reads the same
# igni_<UF>.RDS files this writes. Nothing in a SICAR rebuild or a municipal
# merge changes what it computes: it turns raw hotspots into dated ignition
# POINTS, and neither the hotspot archive nor the clustering parameters move.
# What does need redoing after a municipal-layer change is the st_join further
# down, which assigns each ignition to a municipality, and that is cheap.
#
# So states whose file already exists are skipped. Delete igni_<UF>.RDS to force
# a rebuild for that state. `hotspots` itself is left whole either way, because
# the raw-hotspot panels further down still need every state.
to_cluster = hotspots[
  !file.exists(file.path(DV, paste0("igni_", names(hotspots), ".RDS")))
]

if (length(to_cluster) == 0) {
  message("ignitions: all ", length(hotspots),
          " per-state files already present -- skipping spotoroo clustering")
} else {
  message("ignitions: clustering ", length(to_cluster), " of ", length(hotspots),
          " states (", paste(names(to_cluster), collapse = ", "), ")")
  options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)
  plan(multisession, workers = min(max_workers, length(to_cluster)))

  future_lapply(
    to_cluster,
    future.seed = TRUE,
    future.packages = "spotoroo",
    function(uf_hotspots) {
      uf = uf_hotspots$sigla_uf[1]

      clusters = spotoroo::hotspot_cluster(
        uf_hotspots,
        lon = "longitude",
        lat = "latitude",
        obsTime = "data_pas",
        activeTime = 120,
        adjDist = 750,
        minPts = 5,
        minTime = 3,
        ignitionCenter = "mean",
        timeUnit = "h",
        timeStep = 1
      )

      # --- per-ignition morphology: spread + FRP + crude FRE ----------------
      # size = obsInCluster, duration = clusterTimeLen are already in $ignition.
      # spread = farthest detection from the ignition; FRP recovered from the raw
      # hotspots' frp (spotoroo drops it) by a (lon|lat|time) key; FRE = mean FRP x
      # duration (Wooster 2005 time-integrated energy proxy). Base R only (the
      # future worker loads spotoroo, not dplyr).
      ign <- clusters$ignition
      hot <- clusters$hotspots
      hcl <- hot[!is.na(hot$membership) & hot$membership != -1L, , drop = FALSE]
      mem <- as.character(hcl$membership)
      key_h <- paste(uf_hotspots$longitude, uf_hotspots$latitude, as.numeric(uf_hotspots$data_pas), sep = "_")
      key_c <- paste(hcl$lon, hcl$lat, as.numeric(hcl$obsTime), sep = "_")
      frp_vec <- uf_hotspots$frp[match(key_c, key_h)]
      # FRP-recovery health check: clustered detections whose (lon|lat|time) key did
      # not resolve back to a raw FRP. Should be ~0; a non-trivial rate means the key
      # precision drifted (-> frp_*/fre silently NA). Surfaced per UF, never fatal.
      if (length(frp_vec)) {
        na_frp <- mean(is.na(frp_vec))
        if (na_frp > 0.01) warning(sprintf("[FRE] %s: %.1f%% of clustered detections have unmatched FRP", uf, 100 * na_frp))
      }
      spread_m <- tapply(as.numeric(hcl$distToIgnition), mem, max)
      frp_mean <- tapply(frp_vec, mem, function(z) if (any(is.finite(z))) mean(z, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_)
      frp_max  <- tapply(frp_vec, mem, function(z) if (any(is.finite(z))) max(z,  na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_)
      m <- as.character(ign$membership)
      ign$spread     <- as.numeric(spread_m[m])              # spotoroo distToIgnition units
      ign$frp_mean   <- as.numeric(frp_mean[m])              # MW
      ign$frp_max    <- as.numeric(frp_max[m])               # MW
      ign$fre        <- ign$frp_mean * as.numeric(ign$clusterTimeLen)   # crude FRE (MW.h)

      saveRDS(ign, paste0(DV, "igni_", uf, ".RDS"))
      invisible(NULL)
    }
  )

  plan(sequential)
}


# ---- worker plan for everything below --------------------------------------
# Set explicitly rather than inherited. The clustering block above sets a plan
# only when it actually clusters, so on the common path (all per-state files
# cached, nothing to cluster) no plan would be set at all and every
# future_lapply below -- including build_cnull_panel, the heaviest step in this
# chunk at ~10-20 min per series -- would fall back to sequential. Before this
# was explicit the count came from `length(ufs)`, which a truncated state list
# had quietly cut to 2.
plan(multisession, workers = max_workers)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4 * 1024^3)

# Joining extracted ingnitions from RDS files
ignitions = data.frame()
for (uf in names(hotspots)) {
  ignitions = rbind(
    ignitions,
    readRDS(paste0(DV, "igni_", uf, ".RDS")) %>%
      mutate(sigla_uf = uf)
  )
}

# Convert ignitions to sf points (assuming WGS84 coordinates)
ignitions = st_as_sf(ignitions, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Reproject to match the municipality shapefile CRS (if needed)
ignitions = st_transform(ignitions, st_crs(zones[[1]]$zone))

# ==== LEGACY FIRE-CONCENTRATION BATTERY (not used in the submission) =============
# The specification of record uses only the unbiased timing and spatial HHIs.
# Keep the historical battery parseable for auditability, but do not execute its
# Ginis, tail shares, permutation nulls, co-bursting, space-time tests, tenure
# splits, morphology, or raw-hotspot robustness products.
if (FALSE) {
# ==== ADDED [fire-concentration]: ignition + hotspot concentration + dispersion ====
# NOTE: the raw hotspot archive loop above reads 2019:2025, so these ignition/
# hotspot panels span 2019-2025; pre-2019 years are absent and become NA in the
# analytical panel (feols drops them per outcome). DETER concentration (chunk 2)
# is the series with a full 2016-2025 window. Ignitions are NOT overlaid with
# DETER here -- these are VIIRS ignition events in their own right.
# Both conc panels also carry rarefied (count-robust) tail shares + Gini --
# conc_{igni,hot}_{max1,max3,max7,gini}_rf20 (rarefy_m=20, B=200, seed 20260610);
# see notes/concentration_measures_reference.md sec.11.

# Ignition points with municipality (reused for concentration AND dispersion).
igni_pts = st_join(
  ignitions %>% select(obsTime),
  zones[[1]]$zone %>% select(codmun),
  join = st_within
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(codmun))

# Temporal concentration of ignitions -- the PRIMARY coordination series (calendar year).
conc_igni = build_conc_panel(
  igni_pts %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(codmun, date = as_date(obsTime), w = 1),
  tag = "igni", is_count = TRUE, rarefy_m = 20L
)
# count-conditional permutation-null means (municipality reference law, microreg fallback)
conc_igni = left_join(
  conc_igni,
  build_cnull_panel(
    igni_pts %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% transmute(codmun, date = as_date(obsTime)),
    tag = "igni", micro_map = microreg_lookup
  ),
  by = c("codmun", "year")
)
# cross-municipality co-bursting (synchrony excess vs other-microregion munis,
# season-conditioned) -- the dispersed-simultaneous coordination outcome.
conc_igni = left_join(
  conc_igni,
  build_coburst_panel(
    igni_pts %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% transmute(codmun, date = as_date(obsTime)),
    micro_map = microreg_lookup
  ),
  by = c("codmun", "year")
)
# within-municipality SPACE-TIME interaction tests -- Mantel (vegan, threshold-free
# continuous) + Knox (surveillance, 5 km / 3 day), each a standardized z vs the
# package's permutation/MC null -- the within-muni complement to the cross-
# municipality co-bursting series above. Needs the point geometry (X/Y), so it takes
# the igni_pts sf directly (like build_disp_panel), not the dropped frame.
conc_igni = left_join(
  conc_igni,
  build_spacetime_panel(igni_pts, tag = "igni"),
  by = c("codmun", "year")
)
saveRDS(conc_igni, paste0(DV, "conc_igni_normalyr.RDS"))

# Spatial dispersion of ignitions (convex-hull extent, spatial Gini/HHI, Clark-Evans).
area_lookup = readRDS(paste0(DV, "munic.RDS")) %>%
  distinct(codmun, areamun)
disp_igni = build_disp_panel(igni_pts, area_lookup)
saveRDS(disp_igni, paste0(DV, "disp_igni_normalyr.RDS"))

# Monthly counterparts of the headline timing/spatial HHI and Gini outcomes.
# These retain only positive-count cells; the HHI columns are additionally NA
# when a cell has exactly one ignition because a distinct-event pair does not
# exist. The complete municipality-month panel is restored by the results join.
monthly_igni_indices = build_monthly_ignition_indices(igni_pts, area_lookup)
saveRDS(
  monthly_igni_indices$timing,
  paste0(DV, "conc_igni_monthly.RDS")
)
saveRDS(
  monthly_igni_indices$spatial,
  paste0(DV, "disp_igni_monthly.RDS")
)
rm(monthly_igni_indices)

# ---- Within-tenure ignition concentration (Option A) ------------------------
# OVERLAY: tag each ignition with the land tenure(s) it falls in, then rebuild the
# FULL ignition concentration battery on the ignitions INSIDE each tenure --
#   TIMING     (build_conc_panel)      -> conc_igni_<ten>_{n,max1/3/7,hhi,hhiunb,gini,rbar,...}
#   SPATIAL    (build_disp_panel)      -> disp_igni_<ten>_{sgini,shhiunb,moran,hull,...}
#   SPACE-TIME (build_spacetime_panel) -> conc_igni_<ten>_{mantel_z,knox_z}
# -- a muni x year panel schema-identical to the muni-level conc_igni_*/disp_igni_*,
# so it enters the analytical panel the same way. Reuses igni_pts (muni-assigned,
# zones Albers CRS) + the tenure polygons in `zones`. Membership via the st_intersects
# PREDICATE: a point is "in" tenure t if it lands in ANY of t's polygons --
# lengths(st_intersects(.)) > 0 keeps one row per ignition (st_join would duplicate a
# point in overlapping polygons). st_make_valid guards topology. The 4 designation
# tenures (TI/UC/sett/NDPF) split cleanly; private CAR is added too.
#
# v2: the SICAR layers are now the fixed 2021 masks, one unioned feature per
# municipality, so the v1 property-level dedupe on id_prop is gone with the
# property rows it operated on -- and with it the several-minute pass over
# ~1.2M sicarS polygons. Membership is unchanged: a point is inside the tenure
# if it falls in any of its polygons.
# NB the SPACE-TIME step runs a permutation null (surveillance::knox + vegan::mantel)
# per cell x 6 tenures.
bind_zone = function(pfx)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(which(zones_prefixes == pfx), function(i) zones[[i]]$zone))
tenure_layers = list(
  ti     = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "ti")]]$zone,
  uc     = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "uc")]]$zone,
  sett   = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "sett")]]$zone,
  ndpf   = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "ndpf")]]$zone,
  sicar21_large = bind_zone("sicar21_large"),
  sicar21_small = bind_zone("sicar21_small")
)
igni_ten = igni_pts %>% transmute(codmun, obsTime)          # sf: codmun + obsTime + geometry
for (nm in names(tenure_layers)) {
  igni_ten[[paste0("in_", nm)]] =
    lengths(st_intersects(igni_ten, st_make_valid(tenure_layers[[nm]]))) > 0
}
# TIMING + SPATIAL + SPACE-TIME on each tenure's inside-tenure ignitions.
build_tenure_conc = function(nm) {
  pts = igni_ten %>% filter(.data[[paste0("in_", nm)]])     # sf inside tenure nm
  tg  = paste0("igni_", nm)
  conc = build_conc_panel(
    pts %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% transmute(codmun, date = as_date(obsTime), w = 1),
    tag = tg, is_count = TRUE, rarefy_m = 20L)
  disp = build_disp_panel(pts %>% select(codmun, obsTime), area_lookup, tag = tg)
  st   = build_spacetime_panel(pts %>% select(codmun, obsTime), tag = tg)
  conc %>%
    full_join(disp, by = c("codmun", "year")) %>%
    full_join(st,   by = c("codmun", "year"))
}
conc_igni_tenure = Reduce(
  function(a, b) full_join(a, b, by = c("codmun", "year")),
  lapply(names(tenure_layers), build_tenure_conc)
)
saveRDS(conc_igni_tenure, paste0(DV, "conc_igni_tenure_normalyr.RDS"))

rm(igni_pts, conc_igni, disp_igni, tenure_layers, igni_ten, conc_igni_tenure)

# ---- Fire-morphology outcomes: mean spread (m) + mean duration (h) -----------
# Per-fire physical size from spotoroo: spread = farthest clustered detection from
# the ignition center (m), clusterTimeLen = active duration (h, timeUnit="h").
# Aggregated to muni-year as the MEAN over the year's fires -> "are fires BIGGER /
# LONGER-LIVED?". INTENSIVE (per-fire), hence conditional-on-positive: defined only
# for fire-active muni-years (NA elsewhere -> feols drops them), and it conditions on
# ignition occurrence, which is itself treatment-affected -- so read these alongside
# the extensive-margin count n_igni, not in place of it. Both are heavily right-skewed
# (median spread ~1 km, duration ~2.6 d), so IHS is the natural robustness transform
# (added at the results stage). fire_n carries the muni-year fire count these means
# average over (the low-count filter / sample size).
firemorph = st_join(
  ignitions %>% select(obsTime, spread, clusterTimeLen),
  zones[[1]]$zone %>% select(codmun),
  join = st_within
) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(codmun)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(obsTime)) %>%
  group_by(codmun, year) %>%
  summarise(
    fire_n           = n(),
    fire_spread_mean = mean(spread, na.rm = TRUE),          # m
    fire_dur_mean    = mean(clusterTimeLen, na.rm = TRUE),  # h
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2017, year <= 2025)
saveRDS(firemorph, paste0(DV, "firemorph_normalyr.RDS"))
rm(firemorph)

# Raw VIIRS hotspot concentration + spatial dispersion -- ROBUSTNESS only.
# Hotspots have no codmun; assign by point-in-polygon, parallel by UF. Raw
# detection counts conflate fire size/duration/overpass density (methods note
# sec.3), so this is a cross-check, not the coordination-primary series. Planar
# Albers X/Y are retained (not just codmun/date) so the same events feed the
# spatial-dispersion panel without holding sf geometry for every detection.
options(future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3)
plan(multisession, workers = min(max_workers, length(hotspots)))
hot_events = future_lapply(
  hotspots,
  future.seed = TRUE,
  future.packages = c("sf", "dplyr", "lubridate"),
  function(h) {
    p = st_as_sf(h, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
      st_transform(st_crs(zones[[1]]$zone)) %>%
      st_join(zones[[1]]$zone %>% select(codmun), join = st_within) %>%
      filter(!is.na(codmun))
    xy = st_coordinates(p)                                 # planar Albers X/Y
    p %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      transmute(codmun, obsTime = as_date(data_pas), X = xy[, 1], Y = xy[, 2])
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()
plan(sequential)

conc_hot = build_conc_panel(hot_events %>% transmute(codmun, date = obsTime, w = 1),
                            tag = "hot", is_count = TRUE, rarefy_m = 20L)
# count-conditional permutation-null means (municipality reference law, microreg fallback)
conc_hot = left_join(
  conc_hot,
  build_cnull_panel(
    hot_events %>% transmute(codmun, date = obsTime),
    tag = "hot", micro_map = microreg_lookup
  ),
  by = c("codmun", "year")
)
saveRDS(conc_hot, paste0(DV, "conc_hot_normalyr.RDS"))

# Spatial dispersion of hotspots (declustering robustness cross-check). Raw
# detections conflate fire size/duration/overpass density, so only the count-
# robust members (hull, hull-per-n, bias-corr. spatial HHI, edge-corr. L) are
# surfaced in the results table; the full panel is saved for reference.
disp_hot = build_disp_panel(hot_events %>% transmute(codmun, obsTime, X, Y),
                            area_lookup, tag = "hot")
saveRDS(disp_hot, paste0(DV, "disp_hot_normalyr.RDS"))
rm(hot_events, conc_hot, disp_hot, area_lookup)


# ==== END ADDED ===============================================================
}

# ==== SUBMISSION FIRE-CONCENTRATION OUTPUTS ===================================
# Retain only the two concentration measures used by starlink_results_v3:
#   * conc_igni_hhiunb: unbiased timing HHI over calendar days;
#   * disp_shhiunb: unbiased spatial HHI over the fixed 10-km Albers grid.
# The corresponding event counts are support metadata needed to identify the
# n > 1 cells on which an unbiased pair probability exists.
igni_pts = st_join(
  ignitions %>% select(obsTime),
  zones[[1]]$zone %>% select(codmun),
  join = st_within
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(codmun))

ignition_year = function(obs_time, year_basis = c("calendar", "prodes")) {
  year_basis = match.arg(year_basis)
  if (year_basis == "prodes") {
    year(obs_time) + as.integer(month(obs_time) >= 8)
  } else {
    year(obs_time)
  }
}

timing_hhi_panel = function(points_sf, year_basis = c("calendar", "prodes")) {
  year_basis = match.arg(year_basis)
  points_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(
      codmun,
      date = as_date(obsTime),
      year = ignition_year(obsTime, year_basis)
    ) %>%
    filter(year >= 2017, year <= 2025) %>%
    count(codmun, year, date, name = "n_day") %>%
    group_by(codmun, year) %>%
    summarise(
      conc_igni_n = sum(n_day),
      same_day_pairs = sum(n_day * (n_day - 1)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      conc_igni_hhiunb = if_else(
        conc_igni_n > 1,
        same_day_pairs / (conc_igni_n * (conc_igni_n - 1)),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(codmun, year, conc_igni_hhiunb)
}

spatial_hhi_panel = function(
  points_sf,
  year_basis = c("calendar", "prodes"),
  cell_km = 10
) {
  year_basis = match.arg(year_basis)
  points_sf = points_sf[!st_is_empty(points_sf), ]
  xy = st_coordinates(points_sf)
  points_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    transmute(
      codmun,
      year = ignition_year(obsTime, year_basis),
      cell_x = floor(xy[, 1] / (cell_km * 1000)),
      cell_y = floor(xy[, 2] / (cell_km * 1000))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(codmun),
      is.finite(cell_x),
      is.finite(cell_y),
      year >= 2017,
      year <= 2025
    ) %>%
    count(codmun, year, cell_x, cell_y, name = "n_cell") %>%
    group_by(codmun, year) %>%
    summarise(
      disp_n = sum(n_cell),
      same_cell_pairs = sum(n_cell * (n_cell - 1)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      disp_shhiunb = if_else(
        disp_n > 1,
        same_cell_pairs / (disp_n * (disp_n - 1)),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(codmun, year, disp_shhiunb)
}

conc_igni = timing_hhi_panel(igni_pts, "calendar")
disp_igni = spatial_hhi_panel(igni_pts, "calendar")

saveRDS(conc_igni, paste0(DV, "conc_igni_normalyr.RDS"))
saveRDS(disp_igni, paste0(DV, "disp_igni_normalyr.RDS"))

plan(sequential)
rm(
  igni_pts,
  conc_igni,
  disp_igni,
  ignition_year,
  timing_hhi_panel,
  spatial_hhi_panel
)
# ==== END SUBMISSION FIRE-CONCENTRATION OUTPUTS ==============================

# Spatial join: assigns municipality columns to each point
igni_mun = st_join(
  ignitions,
  zones[[1]]$zone %>% select(codmun),
  join = st_within
) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(year = year(obsTime), month = month(obsTime)) %>%
  group_by(codmun, year, month) %>%
  summarise(n_igni = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

igni_mun = zones[[1]]$zone %>%
  select(codmun) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # The selected Suomi-NPP/NOAA-20 constellation begins in 2019. Earlier years
  # must remain absent rather than being converted into constructed zero counts.
  merge(2019:2025) %>%
  rename(year = y) %>%
  merge(1:12) %>%
  rename(month = y) %>%
  left_join(igni_mun, by = join_by(codmun, year, month)) %>%
  mutate(n_igni = ifelse(is.na(n_igni), 0, n_igni)) %>%
  arrange(codmun, year, month)


# Saving processed data
saveRDS(igni_mun, paste0(DV, "ignimun_monthly.RDS"))

saveRDS(
  igni_mun %>%
    filter(year >= 2017 & year <= 2025) %>%
    group_by(codmun, year) %>%
    summarise(n_igni = sum(n_igni)),
  paste0(DV, "ignimun_normalyr.RDS")
)

rm(hotspots, ignitions, igni_mun, aux)
```

```{r 12}
faction_source_path = paste0(DRAW, "FBSP/amazon_factions_2023_2024.csv")
faction_report_years = c(2023L, 2024L)

# Pool the two report editions into one time-invariant, ever-documented
# presence measure. The source CSV is shipped with the replication package, so
# reproducing the analysis does not require transcribing the Cartografias PDFs.
factions_long = readr::read_csv(
  faction_source_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(report_year %in% faction_report_years) %>%
  transmute(
    codmun = as.numeric(codmun),
    faction
  ) %>%
  # Mojui re-keyed to the merged Santarem unit BEFORE the unique(): a faction
  # present in both members must count once, not twice
  mutate(codmun = merge_codmun(codmun)) %>%
  unique()

stopifnot(
  setequal(unique(readr::read_csv(
    faction_source_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )$report_year), faction_report_years),
  !anyNA(factions_long),
  max(faction_report_years) == 2024L
)

# Collapse to a cross-section. The resulting faction variables do not vary by
# panel year: a municipality is coded Yes in every year if either the 2023 or
# 2024 report documents a faction there.
factions = factions_long %>%
  distinct(codmun) %>%
  mutate(faction = 1L)


# The municipal skeleton, taken from `zones` rather than from a stray `amz` left
# in the environment. This chunk used to reference `amz` without defining it: it
# is built in chunk 13, which runs AFTER this one, so chunk 11 only ever worked
# in an interactive session where something else had already created it. Run
# non-interactively it died with "objeto 'amz' nao encontrado".
factions = zones[[which(zones_prefixes == "mun")]]$zone %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(codmun) %>%
  left_join(factions, by = "codmun") %>%
  mutate(faction = ifelse(is.na(faction), 0, faction))

attr(factions, "time_varying") = FALSE
saveRDS(factions, paste0(DV, "factions.RDS"))
rm(faction_source_path, faction_report_years, factions_long, factions)
```
